info.name: jana2u-pos backend
info.description:
Rust/Axum API backend for jana2u-pos, a point-of-sale system for a repair/retail shop.

All requests inherit the collection-level Bearer auth (`{{accessToken}}`) — set it once per environment (Developement/Production) after obtaining a JWT via Auth > Login (its Tests script auto-populates `{{accessToken}}` for you on success, so nothing to copy/paste). Admin-gated endpoints (inventory category/subcategory writes) additionally require the token's `role` claim to be `admin`. Permission-gated endpoints (Users CRUD, Auth > List Login Sessions) require the token's `permissions` claim to include a specific permission (e.g. `users:manage`, `sessions:view`) — see CLAUDE.md's "Auth, users & permissions" section for the full role→permission table; the seeded Admin (`cargo run --bin seed_admin`) has every permission.

Base URL, and the access token, are environment variables — switch the active Postman environment to point requests at dev vs prod.

item.name: Auth

request.description:
Exchanges email/password for a JWT carrying the account's role and its role's default permission set. No auth required. On success, this request's Tests script auto-populates the `{{accessToken}}`/`{{userId}}` environment variables, so every other request's inherited Bearer auth picks it up immediately.

Use `cargo run --bin seed_admin` to bootstrap the very first Admin account (registration is admin-provisioned only — there is no public register endpoint).

Returns the account the inherited Bearer token belongs to. Re-reads from MongoDB on every call (rather than only decoding the token), so a deactivated account is caught immediately even with a still-valid token.

**Requires a valid JWT** or the API returns 401.

query.description: Restrict to one account's login history

request.description:
Login history audit log — newest first. Each entry snapshots the account's name/email/role at the moment of that login, so it keeps reading the same way even if the account is later renamed. Not paginated the way Suppliers/Products are — this is an append-only log that grows without bound.

**Requires the token's `permissions` claim to include `sessions:view`** (granted to Admin/Manager by default) or the API returns 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`.

request.description: List products with search, filters, pagination and sorting.
Fetch a single product by its Mongo ObjectId.

Create a new product. `categoryKey`/`subcategoryKey` must be a valid pair — the system-generated keys of an existing category/subcategory (see GET /categories/valid), never their display names. Prices are integer cents. `sku` is NOT sent — it's auto-generated server-side from the resolved category/subcategory names (e.g. "PHO-SCR-0001"); the request body has no field for it.
Partially update a product — omit any field to leave it unchanged.
Delete a single product by id.
Delete multiple products at once. Ids that fail to parse as ObjectId are silently skipped.
Adjust a product's stock by a signed delta (positive = receipt, negative = consumption/sale).
List products at or below their minimum stock threshold.
Stock movement (audit trail) history for a single product.
List all categories with their subcategories.

Create a new top-level category with its starter subcategories (by name — each becomes its own subcategory document with a generated key). The response's `key`/`subcategories[].key` are what other requests (Create Product, Update/Delete Category, Add/Remove Subcategory) must use — copy them into the `categoryKey`/`subcategoryKey` collection variables.

**Requires admin JWT** (`role: admin` claim) — inherited Bearer token must be an admin token or the API returns 403 `ADMIN_REQUIRED`.

Partially update a category, looked up by its key. Renaming `name` is a pure display-label change — products reference this category by its immutable key, so nothing else needs to change.

**Requires admin JWT** (`role: admin` claim) — inherited Bearer token must be an admin token or the API returns 403 `ADMIN_REQUIRED`.

Delete a category, looked up by its key. Blocked with 409 while any product still references it; on success also deletes every subcategory under it.

**Requires admin JWT** (`role: admin` claim) — inherited Bearer token must be an admin token or the API returns 403 `ADMIN_REQUIRED`.
Category/subcategory key+name pairs (nested), for a client-side form that needs to display names while submitting `categoryKey`/`subcategoryKey` on product create/update.
List the subcategories of a single category, looked up by its key.

Add a new subcategory to a category (looked up by its key). The response includes the new subcategory's generated `key`.

**Requires admin JWT** (`role: admin` claim) — inherited Bearer token must be an admin token or the API returns 403 `ADMIN_REQUIRED`.

Remove a subcategory (looked up by its key). Blocked with 409 while any product still references it.

**Requires admin JWT** (`role: admin` claim) — inherited Bearer token must be an admin token or the API returns 403 `ADMIN_REQUIRED`.

request.description: List all suppliers (not paginated). No auth required.

Create a new supplier. `key` is server-generated, never client-supplied. The response's `key` is what Supplier Products/Purchases requests reference — copy it into the `supplierKey` collection variable (and the `id` into `supplierId`).

**Requires a valid JWT** (any authenticated user — not admin-gated) or the API returns 401.

request.description: Fetch a single supplier by its Mongo ObjectId. No auth required.

Full replace — same shape as Create Supplier. Any optional field (secondaryPhone/email/notes) omitted from the body is cleared, unlike Update Supplier (PATCH) which leaves omitted fields untouched.

**Requires a valid JWT** (any authenticated user) or the API returns 401.

Partial update — omit any field to leave it unchanged.

**Requires a valid JWT** (any authenticated user) or the API returns 401.

Delete a single supplier by id. Cascades to remove its Supplier Product links. Blocked with 409 `SUPPLIER_HAS_PURCHASES` while any purchase still references it.

**Requires a valid JWT** (any authenticated user) or the API returns 401.

Delete multiple suppliers at once. Ids that fail to parse as ObjectId, don't resolve, or are blocked by the purchase-history guard are silently skipped — the response count reflects only what was actually deleted.

**Requires a valid JWT** (any authenticated user) or the API returns 401.
Every distinct `suppliedCategories` tag currently in use across all suppliers, for autocomplete. No auth required.

item.description: Supplier CRUD: contact/business info plus the free-text category tags a supplier deals in.

item.name: Supplier Products

request.description: Lists links scoped to a supplier, a product, or their intersection. At least one of supplierKey/productKey is required (400 otherwise). No auth required.

Links a supplier to a product. If the (supplierKey, productKey) pair already has a link, updates its costPriceCents/notes in place instead of creating a duplicate. Both keys must reference existing documents (404 otherwise).

**Requires a valid JWT** (any authenticated user) or the API returns 401.

Removes a supplier-product link. 404 `SUPPLIER_PRODUCT_LINK_NOT_FOUND` if no such link exists.

**Requires a valid JWT** (any authenticated user) or the API returns 401.

Replaces every product link for a supplier with the given set of productKeys. Links for product keys that already existed keep their costPriceCents/notes; ones no longer listed are removed.

**Requires a valid JWT** (any authenticated user) or the API returns 401.

item.description: The many-to-many join between suppliers and inventory products.

item.name: Purchases

query.description: Purchase history for one supplier, newest first
Purchase history for one product, newest first

request.description: Purchase history scoped to a supplier, a product, or their intersection — enriched with supplier/product display data. At least one of supplierKey/productKey is required (400 otherwise). No auth required.

Records a stock intake from a supplier. Also increments the product's stockQuantity and writes a PurchaseReceipt stock movement (see Inventory > Stock > Product Stock Movements). Both keys must reference existing documents (404 otherwise).

**Requires a valid JWT** (any authenticated user) or the API returns 401.

item.description: Supplier purchase / stock-intake history — recording a stock receipt also bumps the referenced product's stock in Inventory.

item.name: Users

request.description:
List all user accounts (not paginated — a shop's staff roster is small).

**Requires the token's `permissions` claim to include `users:manage`** (granted to Admin by default) or the API returns 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`.

Creates a new user account — admin-provisioned only, there is no public self-registration endpoint. `role` must be one of `admin`/`manager`/`staff`; its default permission set is computed fresh at that user's next login, never stored on the account.

**Requires the token's `permissions` claim to include `users:manage`** (granted to Admin by default) or the API returns 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`.

Fetch a single user account by its Mongo ObjectId.

**Requires the token's `permissions` claim to include `users:manage`** or the API returns 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`.

Partial update — omit any field to leave it unchanged. `password` present means rehash to the new value (takes effect on that user's next login); `isActive: false` deactivates the account, blocking both future logins and its already-issued tokens' next `GET /auth/me` call.

**Requires the token's `permissions` claim to include `users:manage`** or the API returns 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`.

Delete a user account. Blocked with a validation error `CANNOT_DELETE_SELF` if `{{userId}}` is the caller's own account.

**Requires the token's `permissions` claim to include `users:manage`** or the API returns 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`.
